_about: Crop parameters for the Rotation Lab. Every value has a source or is null (shown on screen as an information gap). Collected with AI help on 11 Nov 2026 and NOT yet reviewed by the team's research lead. Days are days in the field (rice: total duration minus seedbed).

boro_long.name: Long-duration boro rice

source.kc: https://www.fao.org/4/x0490e/x0490e0b.htm (Table 12, Rice: 1.05 / 1.20 / 0.90-0.60; end value is the midpoint)
source.heatC: https://arccjournals.com/journal/agricultural-reviews/R-2353 (over 35 C at flowering raises spikelet sterility)
source.irrigated: Assumption: boro is the dry-season irrigated rice crop. Needs a source.

boro_long.note: ky: rice is not in FAO-56 Table 24, so rain-shortage loss uses the default response.
